user.title: Add a Haier AC
user.description: Sign in with your Haismart email/password, or enter the device details manually. Google/Facebook accounts: create a throwaway email/password Haier account, share your AC(s) to it in the app, then sign in with that account.

menu_options.login: Sign in with email or password

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter your Haismart email (or phone) + password and your region code (phone country code, e.g. 66 Thailand, 65 Singapore). Google/Facebook accounts have no password — create a throwaway email/password account, share your AC(s) to it in the app, then sign in with that account here.

pick_device.title: Choose a device
pick_device.description: Choose which AC to add. Its key is fetched from the cloud and its IP found on your network automatically — you won't need to paste anything.

manual.title: Device details
manual.description: Enter the AC's LAN IP, its device ID (the module's MAC), and its localKey. Device ID is prefilled if the AC was discovered.

reauth_confirm.title: Local key rotated
reauth_confirm.description: The AC {device_id} reports a newer localKey version — the cached key no longer decrypts its status. Enter the AC's current localKey to reconnect.

host.title: Enter the AC's IP address
host.description: Signed in and the key was fetched automatically — Home Assistant just couldn't find {device} on the network by itself. Enter its local IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.50). Tip: a DHCP reservation keeps it stable.

error.invalid_key: The local key must be a 32-character hex string.
error.invalid_auth: The AC answered, but this local key does not decrypt its status (wrong or rotated key).
error.cannot_connect: Could not complete the uSS handshake with the device on the LAN.
error.cloud_auth: Sign-in failed — check your email/phone, password, and region code.
error.no_devices: No devices were found on this account.

abort.all_configured: All of this account's ACs are already added to Home Assistant.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error — the device announcement wasn't understood.

stale_localkey_manual_reauth.title: {name}: localKey rotated — manual re-key needed
stale_localkey_manual_reauth.description: The AC rotated its localKey (v{old} → v{new}) and this device has no cloud credentials to refresh it automatically, so Home Assistant asked you to re-enter a key. To avoid this in future, reconfigure the device with your Haismart account (email/password) so the key auto-refreshes from the cloud on every rotation.
